column4: People who have been labelled villains can be demonized without need to consider the truth or circumstances of their actions. The label of hero can protect a person from all consequences.
You are an ordinary person with an ordinary life. Describe your ordinary Monday morning in the most interesting way possible.
Two vampers stand in the middle of a deserted highway waiting for the sunrise to commit suicide. What's their conversation?
Every social network is a country. Every nation has it's own currency. Facebook has Likes, Tumblr has Notes, etc. Tell me about your great Karma heist.

The Walking Dead is actually a bunch of kids playing zombies, every time someone "dies" its actually their mom and dad calling them to come inside for dinner, homework, etc. Write about a character death from this perspective
Write a short story three times. Each time from a different era.
Your character is a soldier from Ancient Greece - Due to his cowardice in battle, Ares has sentenced him to live through every major war from them to eternity.
You are colourblind. You have been given a pair of corrective glasses, and can now see what everyone else does. But you can see something else too.
Your favorite memory with a group of people.
A gang made entirely of emergency personnel
You hitchhike and get picked up by the Devil.
Only a man who writes can appreciate a good pen.
Writing from the future, explain why the social norms of our time are barbaric and backwards.
Create a character who is very different from you. Tell a story from your own life, but from that character's perspective.

After escaping her life of poverty to the arms her dreamed-of Prince Charming, our young heroine realizes that it was his monarchy that was making life shitty for everyone like her in the first place.

You are a struggling artist, hardly any income, barely paying the rent, no SO. One day, however, you discover that if you draw something at exactly 00:00 and finish at 00:24, the drawing will appear as a real object, right next to you.
You're taking a road trip in a 5 seater car. Each seat is filled with you, but at various points in your life. One of you strikes up a conversation.
Two powerful warriors (soldiers, supers, etc.), sworn to fight to the death, keep finding increasingly ridiculous excuses not to do so just yet
The slip of paper in your fortune cookie is just an address
You're possessed by an evil spirit and gradually losing control over your mind and body as the spirit gains strength. The twist? You're on the altar at your wedding.
Vampires are discovered to no longer be the creation of myths and legends. Their leader? Gail J. McGovern, CEO of the American Red Cross Association.
You are a Rule 34 Enforcement Officer. Your agency's sworn duty: If it exists, there's porn of it. No exceptions.
After humans begin developing psychic abilities, new sports, called "Mind Games" are developed.

You die and now it is day of judgement. To your surprise, the day of judgement is where gods get judged based on how well they did (How fair their world was, pleasant... etc). The judgement of our god is about to start...
The 5-year-old, 15-year-old, and 25-year-old versions of you are living in an apartment together. What happens? (x-post /r/askreddit)
Write a reminiscence of a character who failed an important task.
No, they are right. Kim Jong Un has superpowers and has been hiding it from the world. One day the aliens attack and he decides to do something..
You see yourself as a loser, a nobody. Little did you know that the birds you feed everyday see you as something else entirely.
Everyone wakes up able to speak a random new language, even some that have been unspoken for thousands of years. You find that you can read, write, and speak the lost language of magic.
The universe's most accomplished assassin's latest target turns out to be the universe's most tenacious survivor.

You have just died. The Good News is that there is an afterlife. The Bad News is that it isn't Heaven. Or Hell. Or Purgatory. And you aren't a Ghost. In fact, the afterlife is something that no sane human being would ever predict, and has most likely never been written down.

You have discovered that "God" is actually a computer simulation that is running the entire universe and you have gained access to the console. Upon looking at the screen you see that a service pack to update the program was downloaded 10,000 years ago but never installed.
